fields.description:
**Context** While testing WAGR-427 (streamlined referrer creation), the "Log Sign Up" flow showed the record type selection screen (Operator / Partner / Player / Referrer) when adding a new referrer. Two findings came out of the discussion.

1. **Record type options are controlled at profile level, not per view.** The record type picker is not configurable per screen. Admins always see all record types. For Reps, options are limited through the profile. (Jared Ali, via the WT Rep PSG, is the test user.)
2. **Some Rep users do not see the sign-up action buttons.** Andy Bhiekham has the same PSG setup as Jared Ali, but the sign-up action buttons do not show. Cedrick confirmed the fix: tick the **Flow User** checkbox on the User record.

Not a bug. This is a config gap that could cause wrong test results and a confusing Rep experience.

**Requirements**

* Review every active Rep user in the sandbox and confirm **Flow User** is ticked.
* Fix any Rep user where it is not ticked.
* Confirm the record type options each Rep user sees match what is expected for their profile.
* Log which users were changed (input for the later full permissions check).

**Why now**
Emily can now log in as other users to test. We do not want her testing with a user we have not configured yet.

**Out of scope**

* The bigger permissions review planned for later.
* Changing the record type picker behaviour (covered by WAGR-427).

**Open questions / assumptions**

* Assumption: sandbox only for now. Confirm whether production needs the same check before go-live.
* Unknown: expected record type set per Rep profile. Confirm with Cedrick/Emily if unclear.

**Related**

* WAGR-427: Referrer: Streamline new referrer creation flow
fields.summary: Reps: Audit "Flow User" checkbox and record type access for all Rep users
